pattern: A とか B とか
meaning: Used to express multiple examples or possibilities; 'such as', 'like', 'for example'.
formation: Noun + とか + Noun + とか
ja: 週末は映画とか買い物とか楽しいことをしたいです。
romaji: Shuumatsu wa eiga toka kaimono toka tanoshii koto wo shitai desu.
en: I want to do fun things like watching movies and shopping on the weekend.

pattern: A は B ほど～ありません
meaning: Express that A is not as much as B; 'not as... as', 'not... to the extent of'.
formation: A は B ほど Verb/adjective ありません
ja: 今日は昨日ほど寒くありません。
romaji: Kyou wa kinou hodo samuku arimasen.
en: Today is not as cold as yesterday.

pattern: A は B ほど～ない
meaning: Expressing that A is not as ~ as B; 'not as...as'
formation: A は B ほど + い-Adjective stem (without い) + くない, な-Adjective + じゃない, Verb-negative potential form
ja: 山田さんは鈴木さんほど背が高くない。
romaji: Yamada-san wa Suzuki-san hodo se ga takakunai.
en: Yamada is not as tall as Suzuki.

pattern: A より B のほうが〜
meaning: Comparing two things; 'B is more ~ than A'.
formation: A + より + B + のほうが + Adjective/Verb
ja: 田中さんより鈴木さんのほうが背が高いです。
romaji: Tanaka-san yori Suzuki-san no hou ga se ga takai desu.
en: Suzuki is taller than Tanaka.

pattern: い-Adjective く する/なる
meaning: Express a change happening or making something change.
formation: い-Adjective (remove い) + く + する/なる
ja: 部屋を明るくします。
romaji: Heya wo akaruku shimasu.
en: I will make the room brighter.

pattern: な-adjective に する/なる
meaning: Used to indicate change or decision; 'to become' or 'to make' with na-adjectives.
formation: な-Adjective + に + する/なる
ja: 部屋をきれいにする。
romaji: Heya wo kirei ni suru.
en: To make the room clean.

meaning: Expresses 'only', 'nothing but', or 'no other'.
formation: Noun + しか + Negative Verb
ja: 私はリンゴしか食べない。
romaji: Watashi wa ringo shika tabenai.
en: I eat only apples.

meaning: Used to indicate a choice or decision, 'to decide on' or 'to choose'.
formation: Noun + に + する
ja: メニューからピザにしました。
romaji: Menyū kara piza ni shimashita.
en: I decided on pizza from the menu.

meaning: To become; to change into; to turn into.
formation: Noun + に + なる
ja: 彼は医者になりました。
romaji: Kare wa isha ni narimashita.
en: He became a doctor.

meaning: Used to express purpose or reason; 'for', 'for the sake of', 'in order to'.
formation: Noun + のために
ja: 勉強のために、図書館で静かな場所を探しています。
romaji: Benkyou no tame ni, toshokan de shizukana basho o sagashiteimasu.
en: In order to study, I am looking for a quiet place in the library.

meaning: Expresses 'while' or 'during' a specific period or time.
formation: Noun + の間に
ja: 昼休みの間に銀行に行きます。
romaji: Hiruyasumi no aida ni ginkou ni ikimasu.
en: I will go to the bank during lunch break.

meaning: Expresses 'only', 'nothing but', 'always', or 'just'
formation: Noun + ばかり, Verb-casual + ばかり, い-Adjective + ばかり, な-Adjective + だ ばかり
ja: 彼はお金ばかり話す。
romaji: Kare wa okane bakari hanasu.
en: He talks about nothing but money.

meaning: To give something to someone; 'give', 'offer', 'present'.
formation: Noun + を + あげる
ja: プレゼントをあげる。
romaji: Purezento wo ageru.
en: I give a present.

meaning: To receive or accept something politely; 'to receive', 'to get', 'to accept'.
formation: Noun + を + いただく
ja: プレゼントをいただきありがとうございます。
romaji: Purezento wo itadaki arigatou gozaimasu.
en: Thank you for the gift that I received.

meaning: Used to express someone doing something as a favor or for the benefit of the speaker.
formation: Noun + を + くださる
ja: 先生が資料をくださった。
romaji: Sensei ga shiryou wo kudasatta.
en: The teacher gave me the materials.

meaning: Expresses that someone gives a thing to the speaker or someone close to the speaker.
formation: Giver + が + Receiver + に + Noun + を + くれる
ja: 友達が私にプレゼントをくれました。
romaji: Tomodachi ga watashi ni purezento wo kuremashita.
en: My friend gave me a present.

pattern: Noun を さしあげる
meaning: A polite way of expressing to give something.
formation: Noun + を + さしあげる
ja: 先生に本をさしあげます。
romaji: Sensei ni hon wo sashiagemasu.
en: I will give a book to the teacher.

meaning: To receive or get something from someone; 'to receive', 'to get'.
formation: Noun + を + もらう
ja: 友達からプレゼントをもらいました。
romaji: Tomodachi kara purezento wo moraimashita.
en: I received a gift from my friend.

meaning: Express 'in the middle of', 'during', or 'in the process of'.
formation: Noun + 中 (ちゅう)
ja: 彼は仕事中です。
romaji: Kare wa shigotochuu desu.
en: He is in the middle of work.

meaning: Express the passive causative form; 'to be made to', 'to be forced to'.
formation: Group 1 Verb: Replace ～う with ～わせられる, Group 2 Verb: Replace ～る with ～させられる, Group 3 Verb: する → させられる, くる → こさせられる
ja: 子供たちは先生に宿題をやらせられました。
romaji: Kodomo-tachi wa sensei ni shukudai wo yaraseraremashita.
en: The children were made to do their homework by the teacher.

meaning: Expresses 'to make someone do something', 'to let someone do something', or 'to cause someone to do something'.
formation: Group 1 Verbs: Change the last hiragana to ～せる, Group 2 Verbs: Remove ～る and add ～させる, Group 3 Verbs: する → させる, くる → こさせる
ja: 先生が生徒に宿題をさせました。
romaji: Sensei ga seito ni shukudai o sasemashita.
en: The teacher made the students do homework.

pattern: Verb た ことがある
meaning: Expresses the experience of having done something in the past.
formation: Verb-た-form + ことがある
ja: 日本に行ったことがあります。
romaji: Nihon ni itta koto ga arimasu.
en: I have been to Japan before.

meaning: Express an action or event that occurred at a specific time in the past; 'when', 'at the time'.
formation: Verb-た + ときに
ja: 映画を見たときに、泣きました。
romaji: Eiga wo mita toki ni, nakimashita.
en: When I watched the movie, I cried.

meaning: Expresses the situation right after an action has taken place.
formation: Verb (た form) + ところ
ja: ドアを開けたところ、猫が飛び出してきた。
romaji: Doa wo aketa tokoro, neko ga tobidashite kita.
en: When I opened the door, a cat came jumping out.

meaning: Used to give advice or make a suggestion to someone - 'it's better if...'
formation: Verb (past tense) + ほうがいい
ja: 早く寝たほうがいい。
romaji: Hayaku neta hou ga ii.
en: It's better if you go to bed early.

meaning: Used to describe the purpose or reason for an action; 'for the sake of', 'in order to', 'because of'.
formation: Verb-ます stem + ために, い-Adjective + ために, な-Adjective + なために, Noun + のために
ja: 試験に合格するために、毎日勉強しています。
romaji: Shiken ni goukaku suru tame ni, mainichi benkyou shiteimasu.
en: I study every day in order to pass the exam.

meaning: Express the intention, plan, or determination to do something; 'I intend to', 'I plan to', 'I'm determined to'.
formation: Verb-casual + つもり
ja: 明日、友達に会うつもりです。
romaji: Ashita, tomodachi ni au tsumori desu.
en: I plan to meet my friend tomorrow.

meaning: Used to express doing something for someone; 'do something for someone'.
formation: Verb-て form + あげる
ja: 友達が疲れていたから、荷物を持ってあげた。
romaji: Tomodachi ga tsukareteita kara, nimotsu wo motte ageta.
en: Since my friend was tired, I carried their luggage for them.

meaning: Indicates that an action has been done and its result is still in effect.
formation: Verb-て form + ある
ja: 窓が開けてある。
romaji: Mado ga akete aru.
en: The window has been opened (and remains open).

meaning: Expresses an action that continues on into the future or a change that progresses over time.
formation: Verb in て-form + いく
ja: このまま練習を続けていくと、上達するでしょう。
romaji: Kono mama renshuu o tsuzukete iku to, joutatsu suru deshou.
en: If you keep practicing like this, you will improve.

meaning: Express a polite request or desire that someone does something for you.
formation: Verb-て form + いただきたい
ja: 資料をコピーしていただきたいです。
romaji: Shiryou wo kopii shite itadakitai desu.
en: I would like you to make copies of the documents.

meaning: Used to express receiving someone's favor or help; 'to kindly do'.
formation: Verb-て form + いただく
ja: メールを送っていただいて、ありがとうございます。
romaji: Meeru o okutte itadaite, arigatou gozaimasu.
en: Thank you for kindly sending the email.

pattern: Verb て いただけませんか
meaning: A polite request; 'Could you please...', 'Would you mind...'
formation: Verb-て form + いただけませんか
ja: この手紙を投函していただけませんか。
romaji: Kono tegami wo toukan shite itadakemasen ka.
en: Could you please mail this letter for me?

meaning: Expresses an ongoing action or a state resulting from a past action.
formation: Verb (て-form) + いる
ja: 今、本を読んでいます。
romaji: Ima, hon wo yonde imasu.
en: I am reading a book now.

pattern: Verb て いる ところ
meaning: Describes an action that is currently happening; 'in the middle of', 'in the process of'.
formation: Verb-て form + いる ところ
ja: 彼は宿題をしているところです。
romaji: Kare wa shukudai wo shite iru tokoro desu.
en: He is in the middle of doing his homework.

meaning: Expresses 'while' or 'during the time' something is happening.
formation: Verb-て form + いる + 間に
ja: 映画を見ている間に、彼は寝てしまった。
romaji: Eiga o mite iru aida ni, kare wa nete shimatta.
en: While watching the movie, he fell asleep.

meaning: Perform an action in preparation for a future situation; 'to do something in advance'.
formation: Verb-て form + おく
ja: 駅で切符を買っておこう。
romaji: Eki de kippu wo katte okou.
en: Let's buy the tickets in advance at the station.

pattern: Verb て くださいませんか
meaning: Polite request for asking someone for a favor.
formation: Verb in て-form + くださいませんか
ja: コーヒーを飲んでくださいませんか。
romaji: Koohii o nonde kudasaimasen ka.
en: Would you please drink some coffee?

meaning: Expresses gratitude for receiving someone's favor; 'to kindly do'.
formation: Verb て-form + くださる
ja: 先生が手伝ってくださる。
romaji: Sensei ga tetsudatte kudasaru.
en: The teacher kindly helps.

meaning: An action that starts in the past and continues to the present or future; 'come to', 'begin to', 'become'.
formation: Verb て-form + くる
ja: 最近、日本語が分かってくるようになりました。
romaji: Saikin, nihongo ga wakatte kuru you ni narimashita.
en: Recently, I've come to understand Japanese.

meaning: A polite way to request someone to do something for you; 'Could you please', 'Would you please', 'Won't you'.
formation: Verb-て form + くれませんか
ja: ドアを開けてくれませんか。
romaji: Doa wo akete kuremasen ka.
en: Could you please open the door?

meaning: Expresses that someone does something for the speaker (or another person in speaker's group); 'to do something for me/us'.
formation: Verb-te form + くれる
ja: 友達が宿題を手伝ってくれました。
romaji: Tomodachi ga shukudai wo tetsudatte kuremashita.
en: My friend helped me with my homework.

pattern: Verb て + さしあげる
meaning: A polite way to express giving or doing something for someone.
formation: Verb-てform + さしあげる
ja: お茶を入れてさしあげます。
romaji: Ocha wo irete sashiagemasu.
en: I will prepare and serve tea (for you).

meaning: Expresses unintentional actions or actions with regrettable outcomes; 'to end up doing', 'to accidentally do'.
formation: Verb-te form + しまう
ja: ケーキを全部食べてしまった。
romaji: Keeki wo zenbu tabete shimatta.
en: I ended up eating the whole cake.

meaning: Express a desire for someone else to do something; 'I want (someone) to'.
formation: Verb-て form + ほしい
ja: 子供にもっと勉強してほしい。
romaji: Kodomo ni motto benkyou shite hoshii.
en: I want my child to study more.

meaning: Used to express 'try to' or 'attempt to do'
formation: Verb-て form + みる
ja: この料理を作ってみます。
romaji: Kono ryouri o tsukutte mimasu.
en: I will try to make this dish.

meaning: Express a desire to receive a favor or service from someone else.
formation: Verb-て-form + もらいたい
ja: この荷物を運んでもらいたいです。
romaji: Kono nimotsu o undonde moraitai desu.
en: I want you to carry this luggage for me.

meaning: Express receiving a favor or action from someone.
formation: Verb-て form + もらう
ja: 友達に宿題を手伝ってもらった。
romaji: Tomodachi ni shukudai o tetsudatte moratta.
en: I had my friend help me with my homework.

pattern: Verb てもらえませんか
meaning: A polite way to ask for a favor or request someone to do something.
formation: Verb-て form + もらえませんか
ja: この手紙を見てもらえませんか。
romaji: Kono tegami o mite moraemasen ka?
en: Could you take a look at this letter for me?

pattern: Verb ない ことがある
meaning: Expresses that something doesn't always happen or there are occasions when it doesn't happen.
formation: Verb-negative form + ことがある
ja: 彼は会議に出席しないことがある。
romaji: Kare wa kaigi ni shusseki shinai koto ga aru.
en: There are times when he doesn't attend meetings.

pattern: Verb ない + ことにする
meaning: To decide not to do something.
formation: Verb-ない form + ことにする
ja: 明日のパーティーに行かないことにする。
romaji: Ashita no paatii ni ikanai koto ni suru.
en: I've decided not to go to tomorrow's party.

pattern: Verb ない ことになる
meaning: Expresses a result; 'end up not', 'it will become that', 'it would mean that'.
formation: Verb-negative (ない) + ことになる
ja: 今日彼が来ないことになると、私たちの予定はキャンセルされます。
romaji: Kyou kare ga konai koto ni naru to, watashitachi no yotei wa kyanseru saremasu.
en: If he doesn't come today, our plans will be canceled.

meaning: Expresses the idea that it is better not to do something.
formation: Verb-negative form + ほうがいい
ja: この薬は飲まないほうがいいです。
romaji: Kono kusuri wa nomanai hou ga ii desu.
en: It's better not to take this medicine.

meaning: Expresses 'while' or 'as' in the sense of doing two things simultaneously.
formation: Verb-masu stem + ながら
ja: テレビを見ながら宿題をしました。
romaji: Terebi wo minagara shukudai wo shimashita.
en: I did my homework while watching television.

meaning: A command form used to give orders or instructions; 'Please do', 'Do this'.
formation: Verb-stem + なさい
ja: 部屋を掃除しなさい。
romaji: Heya wo souji shinasai.
en: Clean your room.

meaning: Express difficulty or complexity; 'hard to', 'difficult to', 'not easily'.
formation: Verb-stem + にくい
ja: この字は読みにくいです。
romaji: Kono ji wa yomi nikui desu.
en: This character is hard to read.

meaning: Indicates that something is easy to do; 'easy to', 'easy for'.
formation: Verb-stem + やすい
ja: この本は読みやすいです。
romaji: Kono hon wa yomiyasui desu.
en: This book is easy to read.

meaning: Express intention or plan to do something; 'I think I will', 'I plan to', 'I intend to'.
formation: Verb-volitional + と思う
ja: 明日、映画を見るようと思います。
romaji: Ashita, eiga wo miru you to omoimasu.
en: I think I will watch a movie tomorrow.

meaning: Used to express 'like', 'as if', 'in order to', or 'so that'.
formation: Verb-ますstem + ように, い-adjective + ように
ja: 彼女は鳥のように軽やかに踊る。
romaji: Kanojo wa tori no you ni karoyaka ni odoru.
en: She dances lightly like a bird.

meaning: Make an effort to; try to; see to it that; ensure that.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + ようにする
ja: 毎日運動するようにしています。
romaji: Mainichi undou suru you ni shiteimasu.
en: I try to exercise every day.

meaning: Express a change in ability, situation or state; 'become able to', 'come to', 'begin to'.
formation: Verb-ます（drop ます） + ようになる
ja: 日本語が話せるようになりました。
romaji: Nihongo ga hanaseru you ni narimashita.
en: I have become able to speak Japanese.

meaning: Tell someone to do something; 'tell to do', 'instruct to do'.
formation: Verb-casual + ように言う
ja: 先生は私たちに宿題をやるように言いました。
romaji: Sensei wa watashitachi ni shukudai o yaru you ni iimashita.
en: The teacher told us to do our homework.

meaning: Expresses passive voice or potential form for verbs.
formation: う-verb: Replace the final う with われる (or simply れる for potential form), る-verb: Replace る with られる, Irregular verbs: する → される, くる → こられる
ja: 彼は先生に褒められました。
romaji: Kare wa sensei ni homeraremashita.
en: He was praised by the teacher.

pattern: Verb る ことがある
meaning: Used to express that something happens sometimes or has happened before.
formation: Verb (in る form, remove る) + ることがある
ja: 彼は遅刻することがあります。
romaji: Kare wa chikoku suru koto ga arimasu.
en: He is sometimes late.

meaning: Express ability or possibility of doing an action; 'can', 'be able to', 'is possible'.
formation: Verb-る + ことができる
ja: 私は日本語を話すことができます。
romaji: Watashi wa nihongo wo hanasu koto ga dekimasu.
en: I can speak Japanese.

meaning: Decide to do something, make a decision.
formation: Verb-る + ことにする
ja: 来週、ジムに行くことにしました。
romaji: Raishuu, jimu ni iku koto ni shimashita.
en: I decided to go to the gym next week.

pattern: Verb る ことになる
meaning: Indicates that something has been decided or arranged; 'it has been decided that', 'it turns out that'.
formation: Verb-る + ことになる
ja: 今日は会議がなくなることになりました。
romaji: Kyou wa kaigi ga nakunaru koto ni narimashita.
en: It has been decided that there will be no meeting today.

meaning: Describes the time when a certain action takes place; 'when', 'at the time'.
formation: Verb-る + ときに
ja: 映画を見るときに、ポップコーンを食べます。
romaji: Eiga wo miru toki ni, poppukoon wo tabemasu.
en: When I watch a movie, I eat popcorn.

meaning: Expresses the state or place where an action occurs or is in the process of happening.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + るところ
ja: 彼は食べるところです。
romaji: Kare wa taberu tokoro desu.
en: He is in the process of eating.

meaning: Express the action of taking something out, starting an action, or emphasizing a verb.
formation: Verb stem + 出す (~dasu)
ja: 本を棚から出してください。
romaji: Hono wo tana kara dashite kudasai.
en: Please take the book out from the shelf.

meaning: Indicates the way or method of doing something; 'how to', 'the way of'.
formation: Verb-stem + 方
ja: 誰かがケーキの作り方を知っていますか？
romaji: Dareka ga keeki no tsukurihou o shitteimasu ka?
en: Does anyone know how to make a cake?

meaning: Verbal action is completed; 'to finish', 'to end'.
formation: 終わる (owaru) as a る-verb
ja: 映画が終わったら、家に帰ります。
romaji: Eiga ga owattara, ie ni kaerimasu.
en: When the movie finishes, I'll go home.

meaning: To continue doing or to keep doing an action.
formation: Verb-masu-stem + 続ける
ja: 彼は毎日ジムで運動を続けています。
romaji: Kare wa mainichi jimu de undou o tsuzuketeimasu.
en: He continues to exercise at the gym every day.

meaning: Indicates uncertainty or doubt; 'I wonder', 'I'm not sure'.
formation: Verb-casual + かしら, い-Adjective + かしら, な-Adjective + かしら, Noun + かしら
ja: 今日は雨が降るかしら？
romaji: Kyou wa ame ga furu kashira?
en: I wonder if it will rain today?

meaning: Used to express 'whether' or 'if' in indirect questions or statements.
formation: Verb-casual + かどうか, い-Adjective + かどうか, な-Adjective + (だ)かどうか, Noun + (だ)かどうか
ja: 彼が来るかどうか知りません。
romaji: Kare ga kuru ka dou ka shirimasen.
en: I don't know if he will come or not.

meaning: Expresses uncertainty or wonder; 'I wonder', 'I'm not sure'.
formation: Verb-casual + かなあ, い-Adjective + かなあ, な-Adjective + だ + かなあ, Noun + だ + かなあ
ja: 明日雨が降るかなあ。
romaji: Ashita ame ga furu kanaa.
en: I wonder if it will rain tomorrow.

meaning: Express uncertainty; 'maybe', 'might', 'possibly'.
formation: Verb-casual + かもしれない, い-Adjective + かもしれない, な-Adjective + だかもしれない, Noun + だかもしれない
ja: 明日雨が降るかもしれない。
romaji: Ashita ame ga furu kamoshirenai.
en: It might rain tomorrow.

meaning: Express a reason or cause; 'because', 'since', 'due to'.
formation: Verb-casual + から, い-Adjective + から, な-Adjective + だから, Noun + だから
ja: 雨が降るから、傘を持って行ってください。
romaji: Ame ga furu kara, kasa wo motte itte kudasai.
en: Because it's raining, please bring an umbrella.

meaning: Indicate a soft contrast or contradiction; 'but', 'however'.
formation: Verb-casual + けれど, い-Adjective + けれど, な-Adjective + だけれど, Noun + だけれど
ja: 今日は忙しいけれど、明日はもっと時間がある。
romaji: Kyou wa isogashii keredo, ashita wa motto jikan ga aru.
en: I'm busy today, but I have more time tomorrow.

meaning: Express a polite request to allow or permit someone to do something
formation: Verb-causative form + ください
ja: もう少し考えさせてください。
romaji: Mou sukoshi kangaesasete kudasai.
en: Please let me think a little more.

meaning: Express multiple reasons or characteristics; 'and', 'because', 'since'.
formation: Verb-casual + し,い-Adjective + し,な-Adjective + だし, Noun + だし
ja: 彼は若いし、元気だし、フレンドリーだし、みんなと仲良くなれると思います。
romaji: Kare wa wakai shi, genki da shi, furendorī da shi, minna to nakayoku nareru to omoimasu.
en: He is young, energetic, friendly, and I think he can get along with everyone.

meaning: Expresses that something is excessive or overdone; 'too much', 'too', 'over'.
formation: Verb-stem + すぎる, い-Adjective (remove い) + すぎる, な-Adjective + すぎる
ja: この部屋は暑すぎる。
romaji: Kono heya wa atsui sugiru.
en: This room is too hot.

meaning: Indicates equal distribution; 'each', 'per', 'apiece'.
formation: Noun + ずつ
ja: りんごを2つずつ配ります。
romaji: Ringo wo futatsu zutsu kubarimasu.
en: I will distribute 2 apples each.

meaning: Express the appearance, seeming, or feeling of something; 'looks like', 'seems', 'appears'.
formation: Verb-ますstem + そうだ, い-Adjective (without い) + そうだ, な-Adjective + そうだ
ja: その花はとてもきれいそうだ。
romaji: Sono hana wa totemo kirei sou da.
en: That flower looks very beautiful.

meaning: Expresses 'that kind/type of'; referring to something near listener.
formation: そんな + Noun
ja: そんな話、信じられない。
romaji: Sonna hanashi, shinjirarenai.
en: I can't believe that kind of story.

meaning: Expresses 'not so much', 'not that', or 'not so ~'.
formation: そんなに + Verb-negation, そんなに + Adjective-negation
ja: そんなに急がなくてもいいですよ。
romaji: Sonna ni isoganakutemo ii desu yo.
en: You don't have to hurry that much.

meaning: Expressing a desire or suggestion for a particular outcome; 'it would be good if', 'should', 'I hope'.
formation: Verb-casual-past + たらいい
ja: もっと勉強したらいいですよ。
romaji: Motto benkyou shitara ii desu yo.
en: It would be good if you studied more.

meaning: Making polite suggestions; 'how about if', 'what if', 'it would be good if'.
formation: Verb-casual, past + たら いかがですか, い-Adjective + かったら いかがですか, な-Adjective + だったら いかがですか, Noun + だったら いかがですか
ja: 図書館に行ったらいかがですか。
romaji: Toshokan ni ittara ikaga desu ka.
en: How about going to the library?

meaning: Express a suggestion or advice; 'what if', 'how about', 'why don't you'.
formation: Verb-た form + ら どうですか
ja: スキーに行ったらどうですか？
romaji: Sukii ni ittara doudesuka?
en: How about going skiing?

meaning: Used to list multiple actions or states; 'doing things like', 'and so on', 'etc.'
formation: Verb-ta + り + next verb-ta + り, い-Adjective + かったり + next verb-ta + り, な-Adjective + だったり + next verb-ta + り, Noun + だったり + next verb-ta + り
ja: 週末は映画を観たり、本を読んだりする。
romaji: Shuumatsu wa eiga wo mitari, hon wo yondari suru.
en: On weekends, I do things like watching movies and reading books.

meaning: Express probability, likelihood or certainty; 'probably', 'maybe', 'I think'.
formation: Verb-casual + だろう, い-Adjective (drop い) + だろう, な-Adjective + だろう, Noun + だろう
ja: 明日は晴れるだろう。
romaji: Ashita wa hareru darou.
en: It will probably be sunny tomorrow.

meaning: Used to quote, define, or specify a noun.
formation: Noun/Adjective/Verb + っていう + Noun
ja: ピザっていう料理が大好きです。
romaji: Piza tte iu ryouri ga daisuki desu.
en: I love the dish called pizza.

meaning: Indicates the means, method, or place.
formation: Noun + ～で
ja: 私は自転車で学校に行きます。
romaji: Watashi wa jitensha de gakkou ni ikimasu.
en: I go to school by bicycle.

meaning: A conjecture or probability; 'probably', 'I think', 'it seems'.
formation: Verb-ますstem + でしょう, い-Adjective + でしょう, な-Adjective + でしょう, Noun + でしょう
ja: 明日は晴れでしょう。
romaji: Ashita wa hare deshou.
en: It will probably be sunny tomorrow.

meaning: Expresses prohibition; 'must not', 'cannot'.
formation: Verb-て-form + はいけない
ja: 公園でたばこを吸ってはいけない。
romaji: Kouen de tabako o sutte wa ikenai.
en: You must not smoke in the park.

meaning: To give or ask permission; 'it's okay to', 'may', 'can'.
formation: Verb-て form + もいい
ja: ここで写真を撮ってもいいですか。
romaji: Koko de shashin wo tottemo ii desu ka.
en: Is it okay to take a photo here?

meaning: Expresses 'even if' or 'even though'; used to convey contradiction or contrast.
formation: Verb-て-form + も, い-Adjective (-い) + くても, な-Adjective + でも, Noun + でも
ja: 雨が降っても、学校に行きます。
romaji: Ame ga futte mo, gakkou ni ikimasu.
en: Even if it rains, I will go to school.

meaning: Express a wish or hope; 'I hope', 'it would be good if'.
formation: Verb-casual + といい, い-Adjective + といい, な-Adjective + だといい, Noun + だといい
ja: 明日晴れるといいね。
romaji: Ashita hareru to ii ne.
en: I hope it will be sunny tomorrow.

meaning: Used to define or explain a noun more specifically.
formation: Noun + という + Noun, な-Adjective + という + Noun, Adjectival Verb + という + Noun
ja: 彼は日本語が流暢なアメリカ人という人です。
romaji: Kare wa nihongo ga ryuuchou na amerikajin to iu hito desu.
en: He is a person called an American who speaks fluent Japanese.

meaning: Asking for clarification or more information about a noun; 'what kind of', 'what sort of'.
formation: どういう + Noun
ja: どういう仕事をしていますか？
romaji: Dou iu shigoto wo shite imasu ka?
en: What kind of work do you do?

meaning: Express one's thoughts or opinions; 'I think', 'I believe'.
formation: Verb-casual + と思う, い-Adjective + と思う, な-Adjective + だと思う, Noun + だと思う
ja: 明日晴れると思います。
romaji: Ashita hareru to omoimasu.
en: I think it will be sunny tomorrow.

meaning: Used to quote, express hearsay or define something.
formation: Verb-casual + という, い-Adjective + という, な-Adjective + という, Noun + という
ja: 彼は「好きだ」と言った。
romaji: Kare wa 'suki da' to itta.
en: He said 'I like you'.

meaning: Express a necessity; 'must', 'have to', 'need to'.
formation: Verb-negative + といけない
ja: 明日試験があるから、今夜勉強しないといけない。
romaji: Ashita shiken ga aru kara, kon'ya benkyou shinai to ikenai.
en: I have an exam tomorrow, so I have to study tonight.

meaning: Express a necessity or obligation; 'must', 'have to'.
formation: Verb-casual (negative form without い) + なきゃいけない
ja: 明日までに宿題を終わらなきゃいけない。
romaji: Ashita made ni shukudai wo owaranakya ikenai.
en: I have to finish my homework by tomorrow.

meaning: Express the obligation to do something; 'have to', 'must', 'need to'.
formation: Verb-ない form (-ない ending is dropped) + なくちゃいけない
ja: 仕事に行かなくちゃいけないので、早起きしなければなりません。
romaji: Shigoto ni ikanakucha ikenai node, hayaoki shinakereba narimasen.
en: I have to go to work, so I must wake up early.

meaning: Expresses the necessity or obligation; 'must', 'have to'.
formation: Verb-negative form + なくてはいけない
ja: 宿題をしなくてはいけない。
romaji: Shukudai o shinakute wa ikenai.
en: I have to do my homework.

meaning: Expresses that something is not necessary to do; 'it's okay if not', 'don't have to'.
formation: Verb-ない-form + てもいい
ja: コーヒーは飲まなくてもいいです。
romaji: Koohii wa nomanakutemo ii desu.
en: You don't have to drink the coffee.

meaning: Express obligation or necessity; 'must', 'have to', 'need to'.
formation: Verb-ない form + なければ ならない
ja: 宿題をやらなければならない。
romaji: Shukudai wo yaranakereba naranai.
en: I have to do my homework.

meaning: Indicates direction, destination, purpose, or time.
formation: Noun + に
ja: 母は私にケーキを作りました。
romaji: Haha wa watashi ni keiki wo tsukurimashita.
en: My mother made a cake for me.

meaning: Express a reason or a cause for something; 'because', 'since', 'so'.
formation: Verb-casual + ので, い-Adjective + ので, な-Adjective + なので, Noun + なので
ja: 明日試験があるので、今晩勉強します。
romaji: Ashita shiken ga aru node, konban benkyou shimasu.
en: I will study tonight because there is a test tomorrow.

meaning: Provides an explanation or gives background information; 'the fact is', 'the reason is', 'actually'.
formation: Verb-casual + のです, い-Adjective + のです, な-Adjective + なのです, Noun + なのです
ja: この本は難しいのです。
romaji: Kono hon wa muzukashii no desu.
en: This book is difficult, you see.

meaning: Used to express contrast between expectation and reality, or to indicate a purpose for doing something
formation: Verb-casual + のに, い-Adjective + のに, な-Adjective + なのに, Noun + なのに
ja: 遅刻したのに、先生は怒らなかった。
romaji: Chikoku shita no ni, sensei wa okoranakatta.
en: Even though I was late, the teacher didn't get angry.

meaning: Express a suggestion or advice; 'should', 'it would be good if'.
formation: Verb-ば-form + いい, い-Adjective + ければいい, な-Adjective + であればいい, Noun + であればいい
ja: もっと勉強すればいい。
romaji: Motto benkyou sureba ii.
en: You should study more.

meaning: Indicates extent, 'until', 'up to', 'as far as', 'even'.
formation: Verb + まで, い-Adjective + まで, な-Adjective + まで, Noun + まで
ja: 仕事が終わるまで待っています。
romaji: Shigoto ga owaru made matteimasu.
en: I will wait until work is finished.

meaning: Express 'by' or 'before' a certain time or action.
formation: Verb-casual + までに, Noun + までに, Time expression + までに
ja: 明日の朝８時までに起きてください。
romaji: Ashita no asa hachiji made ni okite kudasai.
en: Please wake up by 8 a.m. tomorrow.

meaning: Express 'as it is', 'while' or 'unchanged state'.
formation: Verb-てform + いる+ まま, Adjective (い & な) + まま, Noun + のまま
ja: ドアを開けたまま出かけてしまった。
romaji: Doa o aketa mama dekakete shimatta.
en: I accidentally left with the door open.

meaning: Indicates similarity, resemblance or 'like'; 'it seems', 'appears', 'looks like'.
formation: Verb-casual + みたいだ, い-Adjective + みたいだ, な-Adjective + みたいだ, Noun + みたいだ
ja: 彼女が病気のみたいだ。
romaji: Kanojo ga byouki no mitai da.
en: She seems to be sick.

meaning: Indicates 'also', 'too', or 'as well'.
formation: Verb-casual + も, い-Adjective + も, な-Adjective + も, Noun + も
ja: 私もお寿司が好きです。
romaji: Watashi mo osushi ga suki desu.
en: I also like sushi.

meaning: Expresses appearance, similarity or inference; 'it seems', 'it looks like', 'it appears'.
formation: Verb-て form + ようだ, い-Adjective (drop い) + ようだ, な-Adjective + のようだ, Noun + のようだ
ja: 彼は元気がないようだ。
romaji: Kare wa genki ga nai you da.
en: He seems to be lacking energy.

meaning: Provide an explanation or reason; 'it is that', 'the thing is', 'the reason is'.
formation: Verb-casual + んです, い-Adjective + んです, な-Adjective + なんです, Noun + なんです
ja: 遅れたんですが、電車が遅れました。
romaji: Okuretan desuga, densha ga okuremashita.
en: I was late because the train was delayed.

meaning: Shows additional information; 'furthermore', 'besides', 'in addition'.
formation: Sentence A + そのうえ + Sentence B + 。
ja: このソフトウェアは使いやすい。そのうえ、価格も手ごろだ。
romaji: Kono sofutouea wa tsukaiyasui. Sono ue, kakaku mo tegoro da.
en: This software is easy to use. Furthermore, the price is reasonable.

meaning: Used to connect two sentences; 'So', 'That's why', 'Therefore'.
formation: Sentence A。それで Sentence B。
ja: 今日は暑いです。それで、エアコンをつけました。
romaji: Kyou wa atsui desu. Sorede, eakon wo tsukemashita.
en: It is hot today. So, I turned on the air conditioner.

meaning: Express 'in addition to; besides,' used to include additional information.
formation: Sentence A + それに + Sentence B
ja: 彼は頭がいい。それに、スポーツも得意だ。
romaji: Kare wa atama ga ii. Soreni, supo-tsu mo tokui da.
en: He is smart. In addition, he is good at sports.

meaning: Express reason or cause; 'because', 'so', 'therefore'.
formation: Sentence A + だから + Sentence B
ja: 明日は試験だ。だから今日勉強しなければならない。
romaji: Ashita wa shiken da. Dakara kyou benkyou shinakereba naranai.
en: Tomorrow is the exam, so I have to study today.
